Class RomanisableString

Namespace: osu.Framework.Localisation
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A string that has a romanised fallback to allow a better experience for users that potentially can't read the original script. See osu.Framework.Configuration.FrameworkSetting.ShowUnicode, which can toggle the display of romanised variants.

public class RomanisableString : IEquatable<RomanisableString>, ILocalisableStringData, IEquatable<ILocalisableStringData>

RomanisableString(string?, string?)

public RomanisableString(string? original, string? romanised)

Parameters

original string?

The string in its original script. If null, the romanised version will always be used.

romanised string?

The romanised version of the string. If null, the original version will always be used.

Remarks

For flexibility, both of the provided strings are allowed to be null. If both are null, the returned string value from osu.Framework.Localisation.RomanisableString.GetLocalised(osu.Framework.Localisation.LocalisationParameters) will be System.String.Empty.
